---
title: "Hierarchical Memory Palaces: Combining Ancient Mnemonics with Modern Retrieval Systems"
subtitle: "A Comparative Study of SMASHIN SCOPE Encoding, Hierarchical Indexing, and Spaced Repetition"
abstract: |
  We present a novel knowledge management system that combines the ancient method of loci
  (memory palace technique) with modern retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) architectures.
  Our system introduces three key innovations: (1) SMASHIN SCOPE encoding for creating
  memorable, multi-channel memory representations, (2) a hierarchical index with verification
  tokens to prevent LLM hallucination, and (3) an adaptive spaced repetition model based on
  Ebbinghaus forgetting curves. We evaluate our approach against standard RAG benchmarks
  (RAGBench, RepLiQA) and validate our memory decay model against 1.7 billion flashcard
  reviews from the FSRS-Anki dataset. Results show 97% reduction in retrieval context,
  80%+ recall accuracy with anti-hallucination guarantees, and decay predictions within
  8% of human memory ground truth.
---
